explication: Codex-X is a Tauri desktop control plane for Codex prompts, providers, sessions, Skills/MCP, configuration, failover, and usage. The principal workflow is: a user operates the React desktop UI, which invokes Rust commands; domain services inspect or update Codex files and local SQLite state, optionally contacting provider, GitHub, or cc-switch integrations. Sampled code strongly supports session scanning, provider authentication, failover routing, Skills/MCP import, and configuration health; some command wiring is inferred only from documented behavior.
